in Massachusetts''' were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the nine [[U.S. representative]]s from the [[U.S. state|State]] of [[Massachusetts]], one from all nine of the state's [[Massachusetts's congressional districts|congressional districts]]. The elections coincided with the [[2024 United States presidential election|2024 U.S. presidential election]], as well as [[2024 United States House of Representatives elections|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, [[2024 United States Senate elections|elections]] to the [[United States Senate]], and various [[2024 United States elections|state and local elections]].
